disciplinary_grounds.description: Any fact or condition exists which, if it had existed at the time of the original application, would have warranted denial of the license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: upon a finding that any fact or condition exists which, if it had existed at the time of the original application for licensure, would have warranted the denying of its issuance

disciplinary_grounds.description: The loan broker violated a provision of this Part or a rule or regulation of the commissioner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: upon a finding that the loan broker violated a provision of this Part or a rule or regulation of the commissioner issued pursuant thereto

disciplinary_grounds.description: The loan broker willfully misrepresented the terms, benefits, privileges, or provisions of any service contract.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the loan broker willfully, either orally or in writing, misrepresented the terms, benefits, privileges, or provisions of any service contract issued or to be issued by the loan broker or by any lender

bonding_required.quote: Every loan broker, except those loan brokers employed by a corporation with a valid loan broker's license, must obtain a surety bond issued by a surety company authorized to do business in Louisiana, or establish a trust account with a federally insured bank or savings institution located in Louisiana.

definition_quote.value: any person who, for compensation or the expectation of compensation, obtains or offers to obtain a consumer loan from a third party either for another person domiciled in Louisiana, or for another person wherever domiciled, if the broker is operating in Louisiana
definition_quote.quote: any person who, for compensation or the expectation of compensation, obtains or offers to obtain a consumer loan from a third party either for another person domiciled in Louisiana, or for another person wherever domiciled, if the broker is operating in Louisiana

registration_fee_annual.quote: The initial license and annual renewal fee shall be five hundred dollars.

advance_fee_prohibited.quote: no loan broker may assess, contract for, or receive any type of fee, interest, or other charge in advance, except for expense deposits under conditions specified in this Subsection, from a potential borrower for the procurement of a loan

surety_bond_or_trust_account_required.quote: Every loan broker, except those loan brokers employed by a corporation with a valid loan broker's license, must obtain a surety bond issued by a surety company authorized to do business in Louisiana, or establish a trust account with a federally insured bank or savings institution located in Louisiana.

surety_bond_minimum_amount.quote: The amount of the bond or trust account shall be twenty-five thousand dollars.

surety_bond_maximum_amount.quote: The amount of the bond or trust account shall be twenty-five thousand dollars.

written_contract_required.quote: Each application for a consumer or federally related mortgage loan in which a loan broker is involved shall be accompanied by a written "Loan Brokerage Agreement and Disclosure Statement" which shall be signed by all contracting parties.

cancellation_right_days.quote: An applicant for a consumer or federally related mortgage loan shall have the right to cancel a "Loan Brokerage Agreement and Disclosure Statement" required by R.S. 9:3572.11 within five business days of signing such agreement.
